items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: He was inventive. He played plain diatonic piano. He had ideas and he learned things, and he pushed them.

ctx.x: So Eddie made the first record of 'Lover Man' that was made. Instrumental. There was no voice. That hadn't come into the picture yet.
Was that on the back of 'Begin The Beguine'?
